today.therapistSees.text: Your therapist will see your progress at your next visit.

habit.hint.text: Tie your session to something you already do each day. You can change the time.

remind.body.text: One reminder at {time} on your days. Nothing else, ever, and you can turn it off in one tap.

remind.notificationFallback.text: Time to move — your Vary Board session.

remind.denied.text: Notifications are blocked for this app in your phone's settings. You can add a calendar reminder instead.

remind.unsupported.text: This browser cannot show reminders from the app. You can add a calendar reminder instead.

a2hs.title.text: First, add Vary Board to your Home Screen

a2hs.why.text: On iPhone, app reminders only work once the app is on your Home Screen.

a2hs.step1.text: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.

a2hs.step2.text: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

a2hs.step3.text: Open Vary Board from your Home Screen and turn on reminders in Settings.

note.helper.text: Do not enter patient names or health details. Up to 120 characters, shown under your patient's session card.

settings.chair.text: I use a chair or wheelchair

settings.chairHint.text: When an exercise has a seated version, the app uses it automatically.

builder.warnLong.text: Five or more exercises. Shorter sessions are easier to keep up; consider a second session.

builder.max.text: A session holds up to 6 exercises. Add another session for more.

builder.overTime.text: Over 15 minutes. Shorter sessions are easier to keep up.

privacy.pushLine.text: If you turn on reminders, your phone's push address, the reminder time, your time zone and your chosen days are stored so one reminder a day can be sent. Turning reminders off stops them.

privacy.deviceLine.text: The app creates a random device number on your phone. It is not linked to your name, email or phone number.

workout.setup.text: Set up the board as shown. The suggested anchor is lit; adjust to what feels comfortable.

workout.feelNote.text: Compared with last time. Saved on this phone.

workouts.intro.text: Press play and follow along. Every workout is built from Dr. Eric's Vary Board movements.

workouts.findBody.text: Three quick questions, then a workout and a plan to follow.

workouts.codeNote.text: Have a code from your therapist? Their plan comes first: enter it in Care.

find.goal.text: What would you like to work on?

find.position.text: How would you like to move?

find.minutes.text: How much time do you have?

find.planIntro.text: Then keep going with a plan

find.note.text: These are general suggestions, not a plan from your therapist. If you are under a therapist's care, follow their plan first.

today.startBody.text: Follow your therapist's plan with their code, or answer three quick questions to find a workout.
